title: Vibrant Weeknight Australian Rhubarb Poached
description: A flavorful, tender, and colorful Australian-inspired dessert featuring poached rhubarb. Perfect for a quick weeknight treat.
instructions: Combine rhubarb, sugar, water, lemon juice, star anise, and pink peppercorns in a large saucepan.
Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer.
Once the mixture is simmering, reduce the heat to low and poach for 15-20 minutes or until the rhubarb is tender.
Remove the star anise and bay leaves from the poaching liquid and stir to combine.
Transfer the poached rhubarb to a fondue pot and serve warm.
Garnish with additional lemon juice and sugar to taste, if desired.
Serve over yogurt or oatmeal for a delicious breakfast or brunch option.
Store leftover poached rhubarb in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
